scope: Independently authored American-English segment expectations for the baseline Lite vocabulary. Primary stress for specified content words is checked; expressive length and t/flap allophony are outside this gate. Listed alternatives permit weak forms and common American vowel variation. Not candidate snapshots and not acoustic approval. CMU pinned source independently confirms here/hear HH IY1 R; /iɹ/ and /ɪɹ/ are accepted for these words. Weak /ɐ/ is accepted separately from /ə/ for a/am. Contractions and repeated compounds are included as lexical tokens.
